Commentary.Commentary: That concludes the proceedings for yet another one-sided match. On 15th September (Thursday), these two teams will clash in the third T20I at 11 pm IST (5.30 pm GMT) to decide the winner of this series. As always, you can join us in advance for the build-up. Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Smriti Mandhana (79* off 53 balls) is the Player of the Match. Says that after the last match, they were keen to come back stronger and she was pushing herself to not play any rash shots. She is happy to contribute and help the team level the series. Regarding her good form in England, Mandhana tells that maybe it's due to the good weather to bat and the pitches are also good. Shares that it was one session when she found her touch back and is happy to go out there and try and give her team a good start. On the batting plans with Shafali Verma, Smriti replies that it depends on the day and Verma is also at that age when she knows her strength and together they plan better on which bowler to target.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the captain of India Women, says that she is very happy with the effort and admits that in the last game, the intent was missing. Mentions that they have plans for every batter but it is important to execute the plans in the middle. Tells that they wanted to show the intent with their fielding and credits Radha for her efforts as well after getting injured in the first game. On batting with Smriti Mandhana, Kaur replies that when they bat together, they have confidence as they can calculate the approach and batting with Mandhana is easier.

Amy Jones, the captain of England Women, says that they were under par with their total but after the start they had, it was a brilliant recovery from Freya Kemp and Maia Bouchier. Regrets that they didn't have the total to defend. Adds that as a team they want to play fearlessly and she praises the two girls (Bouchier and Kemp) for their partnership. Further adds that it's great to see Freya Kemp putting on a show with the bat so early in her career. Feels that India batted really well and England failed to execute their plans with the ball.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

We can call it a role reversal from the first game! India Women were far superior in all the departments, and England Women were always behind the eight ball. With the bat, they lost five wickets in a hurry, and Freya Kemp's counter-attacking knock handed them a fighting total. The hosts would have hoped for early inroads with the ball, but that didn't happen, and dew made their task even tougher as India Women cruised home without breaking a sweat. Smriti Mandhana put on an attractive batting show and remained unbeaten and she was well supported by skipper Harmanpreet Kaur.

Excellent response from India Women after going down in the series in Chester-le-Street. They got their act together, first with the ball and on the field, and then the batters stepped up to scale down the target with utmost ease. The Indian openers dominated the first 35 balls of the Powerplay and wrestled the game in their corner very early. The series now stands at 1-1, and we will have a decider on Thursday.

FOUR! Done and dusted in style! Freya Davies serves it on a fuller length, around off, Smriti Mandhana fires it aerially over mid off for a boundary. India Women win by 8 wickets with 20 balls to spare.
FOUR! Fuller in length, on middle, Smriti Mandhana walks forward and whips it towards wide long on for a boundary. Scores level.

Freya Davies serves a full toss way above the waist height of the batter, Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it towards deep square leg for a single. It is called a no ball and the bowler is also given a warning. Free Hit coming up...
A slower ball, full and on leg, Smriti Mandhana tucks it away through mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! 8 needed more! Full toss down the leg side, Smriti Mandhana goes down and nails her sweep shot behind square leg for a boundary.
Freya Davies comes back to bowl.
This is full and outside off, Smriti Mandhana slices it uppishly towards deep cover, and the ball falls way short of the fielder. They cross.

Short and on middle, Smriti Mandhana stays there and pulls it wide of deep mid-wicket where Danni Wyatt dives and parries it towards Maia Bouchier who returns the ball to the keeper. Two runs are taken.
Goes fuller this time, on middle, Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards covers.
Bell takes the pace off and lands this short of a length, outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur moves across and guides it towards short third man where a fumble allows the batters a single.
A loopy full toss, on off, Smriti Mandhana watches it through and drives it down to long on for a run.
Bell starts with a slower delivery, on a length and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur waits for it and tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Lauren Bell is back on.

FOUR! Oh, cheeky shot! This is clever batting! A fuller one, around middle and leg. Smriti Mandhana shuffles across and scoops this one over short fine leg. Lauren Bell chases that one, but the ball wins the race. A boundary!
Outside off, a tad short. Smriti Mandhana hangs back and looks to guide this one towards third man but she misses. Half-an-appeal there from the bowler, but the umpire is not interested.
Another flighted delivery full, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur steps down the pitch and strokes it down to long off for a single.
Loopy ball, full, around middle. Smriti Mandhana shows the full face of her bat and knocks it towards long off for a single.
Fires this one outside off, a shortish ball. Smriti Mandhana looks to cut this one away but she misses.
FOUR! Put away! India Women are in a hurry here! Short ball, around middle, Smriti Mandhana swivels and pulls it through square keg for a boundary.
Sophie Ecclestone (2 -0-12-1) replaces Sarah Glenn.
Fraction short now, around middle. Smriti Mandhana pulls it towards square leg for a single.
A length ball, around middle, Smriti Mandhana hangs back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Slower one now, full and outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur drives it towards covers and takes a single.
FOUR! In the air and in the gap as well! Lovely shot! A length ball, around middle and leg. Harmanpreet Kaur backs away and hoicks this one in the cow corner region for a boundary.
Well bowled! Yorker now, around the off pole. Harmanpreet Kaur makes room and does well to squeeze this one towards point.
A fuller ball, around middle. Smriti Mandhana makes room and hits this one straight down the ground. Only a single.
Freya Davies is back on. She gave away just 8 runs in her first two overs and also picked up a wicket.
Short ball again, around middle, this one stays low as well. Smriti Mandhana does well to swipe this one towards square leg for a single.

PUT DOWN! Danni Wyatt is the culprit! A fuller ball, around middle, looped up as well. Harmanpreet Kaur gets down on her knee and slog-sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket. Danni Wyatt there gets her hands to the ball, but she fails to pouch it, it hits her chest and falls to the ground. A single taken.

That will be fifty for Smriti Mandhana! A brilliant knock from her so far, she will want to take her side home from hereon. A fuller ball, outside off, it's tossed up, Smriti Mandhana drives it wide of long off for a single.
A full toss now, around middle, Harmanpreet Kaur gets low and sweeps it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Nicely put away! Sarah Glenn drags her length short again, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur punches it off the back foot away from the diving fielder at covers for a boundary.
Sarah Glenn drops it short, around middle. Smriti Mandhana goes back in her crease and swipes this one towards deep mid-wicket for a single. That brings up the 100 for India Women!
Change of ends for Sarah Glenn (2-0-19-0).
Angling in, a length ball, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur prods forward and defends this one out. India Women need 44 more off 48 balls.
Slightly short now, around middle. Smriti Mandhana swivels and pulls it towards deep square leg. Only a single.
Takes the pace off this time, a fullish ball, around middle and off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it back to Lauren Bell.
A low full toss, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur leans and drives it towards Sophie Ecclestone at mid off. She fumbles to stop the ball and the batters sneak in a single.
Over the wicket now, another good-length delivery, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur pushes it off the back foot towards cover-point for a single.
Lauren Bell speeds in from 'round the wicket, delivers a length ball, angling in, around middle. Smriti Mandhana nudges it towards mid-wicket. The batters cross ends.
Lauren Bell comes back into the attack now. She has conceded 14 runs in her two overs.
Drifting in, around middle and off, quicker as well. Smriti Mandhana knocks it towards long off and ends the over with a single.
A loopy ball now, pitches it up, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur leans forward and drives it towards cover. Single taken.
Angling this one in, a short ball, around middle. Smriti Mandhana pulls it gently towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Tad shorter, around middle and off. Harmanpreet Kaur pushes it off the back foot towards long off for a single.
Wide! Sprays this one down the leg side again, fuller ball. Harmanpreet Kaur misses her sweep this time. Wide given.
'Round the wicket to the right-hander now, down the leg side, fuller ball. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps this one towards short fine fine leg.
Sophie Ecclestone comes in from the over the wicket, she serves a short ball, around middle, Smriti Mandhana pulls this one towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Sophie Ecclestone is back on!
Smriti Mandhana flicks this short delivery off her back foot through mid-wicket and picks up another single.
Another single as this short ball is pulled away towards deep mid-wicket by Harmanpreet Kaur.
Glenn bowls this short again and on off, Smriti Mandhana goes on her back foot and pushes it towards long on for just a run.
A loopy delivery, lands full and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur goes down and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! Put away again! Another half-tracker from Sarah Glenn. Around middle, Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it firmly to deep mid-wicket where Freya Kemp puts in a dive but it clips her wrist and loops over the rope.
FOUR! Well put away! Sarah Glenn drags her length short and delivers it on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur goes back, clears her front leg and smashes it in front of square on the leg side for a boundary.
Sarah Glenn comes back to bowl. She went for 7 runs in her first over.
Another full delivery and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur flicks it through square leg for a single and gets off the mark.
Fuller one and on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur drives it past the bowler, but mid off cuts it off.
The skipper of India Women, Harmanpreet Kaur comes to bat.

OUT! Off stump is pegged back! A cross-seam delivery, landing on a length around off and hurries into the batter. Dayalan Hemalatha stays back as she tries to push inside the line. Misses and the ball goes on to uproot the off pole. England Women get their second breakthrough. Can they capitalize? 66 needed off 68 balls.
This is almost on a yorker length and on off, Dayalan Hemalatha looks to dig it out but misses, and Amy Jones behind the stumps does well to grab it.
Davies serves this on a good length and around off, angling away, Smriti Mandhana stays there and punches it towards sweeper cover for a run.
This is full and on the pads, Dayalan Hemalatha flicks it away towards deep square leg for a single.
Freya Davies is back to deliver her second over.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Dayalan Hemalatha drives it down to long on for a run. 13 runs from the over!

Gives it some air this time, on middle and leg, Dayalan Hemalatha goes down and scoops it towards short fine leg where Lauren Bell dives to her right and gets a hand to it to make a half stop. Two runs are taken.
Quicker one, full and on middle, sliding in, Dayalan Hemalatha knocks it towards short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Fine shot! Alice Capsey tosses this one up and lands it full around off, Dayalan Hemalatha steps down and lifts it over extra cover for a boundary.
A bit short and outside off, Dayalan Hemalatha opens the face of her bat and guides it towards point.
Flighted delivery, full and on leg, Smriti Mandhana eases it towards long on for a single.
FIVE WIDES! Beats everyone. Fuller one, down the leg side, Smriti Mandhana tries to sweep but misses and Amy Jones also fails to collect it. The ball scoots behind and finds the fence.
A single to end the over as this full delivery is driven towards long off.
Tossed up, full and on off, Smriti Mandhana leans on and blocks it towards extra cover.
FOUR! Put away! A nothing delivery, short and on middle, Smriti Mandhana turns inside the crease and pulls it towards long leg for a boundary.
Shortish again and on middle, Dayalan Hemalatha stays in her crease and pulls it over the mid-wicket fielder for a brace.
Shorter in length and on around off, Dayalan Hemalatha stays there and tries to cut it away but misses.
Sarah Glenn begins with a floater, a bit short and on middle, Smriti Mandhana flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Dayalan Hemalatha walks out to bat at number 3. Also, Sarah Glenn is ready to bowl...

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! A terrific reflex catch from Sophie Ecclestone and England Women get the much-needed breakthrough on the last ball of the Powerplay. 88 needed off 84 balls. Flatter delivery, it's fired in full and around off, Shafali Verma forces it straight back and it's aerial. The ball hurries to the right side of the bowler who reacts quickly and grabs it with both hands. The opening partnership for India Women is broken but they are placed better than England Women at this stage of the match.
Darted full and on the leg stump line, angling in too, Shafali Verma looks to go for the slog-sweep but misses and gets hit on her pads as the ball goes nowhere.
Flatter and quicker, on off, Smriti Mandhana works this down to long on for a single.
FOUR! What a shot! Flighted delivery, landing full around off, Smriti Mandhana steps down the track and lofts it over extra cover for a delightful boundary.
Slower through the air, short and on off, turning in, Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards point.
Sophie Ecclestone starts with a short delivery, on middle, angling in, Shafali Verma knocks it to the leg side off her back foot for a single.
Change in bowling. Sophie Ecclestone to bowl the final over of the Powerplay.
Takes the pace off this one, darting it on the pads. Shafali Verma nudges it towards square leg and takes a single. 19 runs off that over. A big one for India Women.

FOUR! Make that four boundaries in the over. This time it's Shafali Verma who puts it away. Freya Kemp drops it short again, around middle. Shafali Verma makes room and pulls it powerfully over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Smriti Mandhana knocks it towards covers and takes a single.
FOUR! Third boundary of the over! Another crisp shot. Short and width on offer now. Smriti Mandhana hangs back and punches it through cover-point for another four.
Outside off this time, another length delivery. Smriti Mandhana taps it towards cover.
FOUR! Smriti Mandhana takes full advantage of the Free Hit! A length ball now, around middle. Smriti Mandhana heaves this one over mid-wicket for another four.

NO BALL AND FOUR! Smriti Mandhana greets Freya Kemp with a boundary! She delivers a short ball, around middle. Smriti Mandhana swivels and pulls it powerfully over mid-wicket for a cracking boundary. Freya Kemp has overstepped here and a no ball is called. Free Hit coming up.
FOUR! Crunched! Tossed-up delivery, full, around off. Shafali Verma gets down on her knee and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary. 11 runs off the over.
Loopy ball, pitches it up, around middle. Smriti Mandhana knocks it towards mid on and takes a single.
This one spins in, from outside off, a tad shorter. Smriti Mandhana stays in her crease and pushes it towards mid-off.
FOUR! Up and just away! Short ball, around middle. Smriti Mandhana uses the depth of her crease and pulls it just away from the diving fielder at square leg for a boundary.
Tosses this one up, fuller ball, around off. Smriti Mandhana drives it towards cover. Not in the gap though.
Bryony Smith comes in from 'round the wicket, serves a shortish ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana opens the face of her bat and guides it towards third man for a brace.
Bryony Smith is into the attack now.
Another dot to end the over. Tad slower, a length ball, outside off. Shafali Verma taps it towards the fielder at cover.
On a length, outside off. Shafali Verma rocks back and dabs it towards cover. A dot ball.
FOUR! Another boundary in the over. This has been punished. Slightly short, around middle and off. Shafali Verma slaps this one over mid on for four runs.
On a good length, around middle and off. Shafali Verma miscues her drive towards cover.
Outside off now, another length ball. Shafali Verma rocks back and pushes it towards extra cover where Sophia Dunkley makes a diving stop.

FOUR! Shafali Verma was waiting to go downtown. She gets this one away. A length ball, swinging in, around middle. Shafali Verma tonks this one over the fielder at mid on. The ball takes a couple of bounces before crossing the fence.
Fuller now, swinging in a tad, around middle. Smriti Mandhana drives it firmly but straight to the fielder at mid on. 5 runs off Freya Davies' first over.
Angling in, around middle and leg, a length ball. Smriti Mandhana walks across and knocks it to the fielder at mid on.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Fraction short again, down the leg side. Smriti Mandhana swivels and pulls it gently through square leg for a boundary.
Slightly short now, outside off. Smriti Mandhana pushes this one off the back foot towards mid off. No run there!
Pulls her length ball, around middle and off. Shafali Verma works it away towards mid on for a single.
Swing and a miss! Good ball to begin with. A fuller one, swinging away, outside off. Shafali Verma advances down the pitch and looks to go downtown but she misses.
Freya Davies to bowl from the opposite end.
Lauren Bell ends the over with a length ball, around off. Smriti Mandhana drives this one on the up firmly but to the fielder at mid off. 6 off the first over.

FOUR! Oh, shot! Smriti Mandhana gets off the mark in fine fashion! A length ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana steps down the pitch, gets on top of that one, and punches it through cover-point for a boundary.
Fuller now, shaping away from the left-hander, wide of off again. Smriti Mandhana leaves it alone.
Wide! Angling away now, a length ball, wide of off. Smriti Mandhana looks to cut this one but she misses. Wide called.

Tad fuller now, angling in, around middle. Shafali Verma steps down the pitch and drags this one from the inner half of her bat through square leg for a single. India Women and Shafali Verma are up and running!
On a length again, tailing back in, around middle. Shafali Verma blocks this one towards mid on.
Lauren Bell begins with a length ball, this one nips back in a tad, outside off. Shafali Verma guides it towards short third man.
